description: This source file contains unit tests for the PDFsharp library focusing on image processing capabilities. It includes tests for creating PDFs with embedded images from files, streams, and HTTP sources, as well as image extraction and resizing, using Xunit and FluentAssertions.

classes.name: ImageTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying image embedding and extraction functionalities in the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: PDF_with_Images
methods.description: Creates a PDF document with drawn shapes and embeds an image file. Saves and displays the PDF for verification.

methods.name: WriteAndRead_PDF_with_FlateDecode
methods.description: Creates a PDF with images and draws, then reads back the document, extracts, and saves images after deflate decoding.

methods.name: PDF_with_Image_from_stream
methods.description: Creates a PDF with an image loaded from a stream, saves, and displays it.

methods.name: PDF_with_Image_from_private_memorystream
methods.description: Creates a PDF with an image loaded from a private MemoryStream, saves, and displays it.

methods.name: PDF_with_Image_from_public_memorystream
methods.description: Creates a PDF with an image loaded from a publicly accessible MemoryStream, saves, and displays it.

methods.name: PDF_with_image_from_GDI
methods.description: Uses GDI+ to load images from files, embed in PDF, save, and display. Conditioned on GDI support.

methods.name: PDF_with_Image_from_http_stream
methods.description: Downloads an image from an HTTP URL into a stream, embeds in a PDF, saves, and displays it. Asynchronous.
